description: List the company label groups: sets of labels where a work item or initiative carries at most one label of the group (for example an "Implementation stage" group with one label per stage). Each group has an `id`, a `name`, its ordered `labels` and `appliesTo` (`work_items`, `initiatives` or `both`). A group's name is not itself a label on any item: to find the items at one stage pass that stage's label to anyforge_list_work_items as `label`.
name: anyforge_list_label_groups
title: List label groups
